## Affected page and reader problem

Link the public page and quote only the wording needed to locate the issue.

## Proposed correction

Describe the accurate wording or navigation change.

## Public evidence and limits

Link a public source or explain what still needs verification. Distinguish
implemented code, historical measurements, synthetic examples, and future plans.

## Checks

Mention any local documentation checks or link checks already performed.
